cohort: 192 primiparous women aged 18-35 who delivered between January 2020 and December 2021, had a gestational age of 38-42 weeks, an infant APGAR score >=8, and no history of mental illness.
finding: The multidisciplinary health education (iHealth) program significantly improved postpartum mental health and enhanced the quality of life for new mothers at six weeks and three months postpartum.
